config.seed_interpretation: Each seed jointly changes generated data, split, weight initialization and shuffle order.
config.endpoint_policy: Final budget endpoint only. No checkpoint or hyperparameter selection on test set.
config.uncertainty: Sample SD across five pipeline seeds, ddof=1; not a confidence interval.
config.budget_caveat: Equal updates does not equalize processed observations, floating-point work or wall time.

clipped_loss_caveat.explanation: Original probability clipping caps loss at -log(1e-12); backward still uses the unclipped softmax-cross-entropy derivative.
